result:
The card can't open yet, because the sheet it has to show does not exist. I didn't open it blind.

**Where the four looks actually stand.** The game still has no switch for the world's colour: the look rig has three settings (the bed, the station cue, the already-done reply) and nothing for the world. Jade's change to add that switch was held back by a file collision and is queued to run again. Yuki's higher-detail sheet got your spend approval this morning and is queued, but nothing in any item lets the rig draw it once it exists. So there are no captures, and a card that cites a missing sheet renders on your inbox as a quiz with words and no pictures, plus a developer command telling someone to go run the rig. That is exactly the blind pick you told us not to put in front of you.

**Two things I found that would have sent the sheet wrong.**

- Jade's queued brief still says warm and cool. Ingrid closed the list on Wednesday as today, quiet world, cold light, and more detail, and dropped warm. Built as written, the sheet would show a look the session no longer tests. I did not edit her item from here, because the drain rewrites those files itself while it runs. It is a one-line correction in the session.
- The "more detail" panel has no path into the rig. Yuki's sheet is a set of sprite files, and the rig only shoots what the running game can draw, so someone has to give the rig a setting that swaps the shipped atlases for hers. Without that, you get three panels, not four.

**What is ready.** The card text you accepted last time stands: the farm, same morning, four ways, the question "Which one is Tiny Farm?", and the recommendation for the quiet world, where only the things you can touch are bright. It will open as the re-ask of the style-guide card, the same way earlier re-asks did, once the sheet is published. The rig needs a display, and a worker on the desktop has one, so shooting and publishing is a worker's job, not yours.

**What I changed.** One note in my seat's running notes: the checks to make before a look card is written, so the next one doesn't get drafted against a sheet that isn't there. Nothing else in the tree.

Not finished. Blocked on the world-colour switch and a way for the rig to shoot the detail sheet, both Jade's; the correction to Jade's brief is mine.
